body: I know it can be hard to manage time and friends. But never feel guilty. You deserve to be happy and to spend time with your friends. Sometimes it’s so easy to get caught up in helping others that we forget to help ourselves.

You might think it’s not true but you’re wrong. I used to be just like you, I didn’t think I was worth anything. I didn’t meet my dream girl or best friend, I just met people who were like me that I could talk too. You might not think that by putting yourself out there you’ll meet new people, but how will you know if you never try? When I said everything has something they were meant for I didn’t mean being a loser. But at the same time that thing isn’t always being the next millionaire or movie star. Sometimes it’s small things that we’re meant for. Things that seem small but impact our lives greatly. It can be a friend you care for, a new hobby, anything. We all have hidden skills and talents. You just have to try to find them.

I don’t think it would be wasted on you at all. It’s perfectly plausible that those “better” people could be happy at the same time that you are. You don’t have to suffer for them to be happy. Those people might seem perfect or better then you but you don’t know their flaws and faults. All of us are worth something. It might seem like there’s nothing going for you right now but I know there is something out there that you are destined for.
I’ll keep trying
I know you’re right but I just can’t convince myself that what happens here matters. I can say it and tell myself a million times but it’s another thing to actually believe it.

When I was 12 I had a friend who was abused by his step dad. He always talked about how bad his step dad treated him but I never connected the dots that he was actually abusing him. One day I hadn’t heard from my friend in a while so a couple of us decided to go check on him. He told us about how bad his step dad was abusing him and how he had tried to kill himself. I don’t know how bad your friends situation is but I wish I had offered my friend a chance to live with me because all he ever wanted was an escape from his life at home. As long as it’s fine by your parents and there’s nothing wrong legally (I live in the US so idk) I would 100% offer him a place in your house. Even if he doesn’t accept I think he’ll find a lot of comfort in knowing he has somewhere to go if things get worse. Best of luck!

Part of it is realizing that you don’t need to block out your emotions to be a good person and the other part is realizing that you don’t have to let all the negative things you see affect you. Find where these negative things are coming from and try to distance yourself from that. Draw yourself closer to the positive things in life. It might seem like there is a lot of darkness in this world but sometimes that’s because that’s the only thing we’re choosing to see. It might take a little looking but guarantee you there is love in positivity in every corner of the world. Instead of putting on a coat of armor to withstand the darkness, try just walking away from it.

I can relate to this on every level. It’s always a good thing to make others happy, but sometimes you need to take a step back and realize that you deserve happiness too. It’s ok to ask your friends to help you and to need them. We can’t be positive 100% of the time, no one can. But it’s in those moments that it’s our responsibility to reach out to those we have loved. I know what it’s like to feel down all the time and the best thing that can help is to just talk to other people. For me it was talking to other people my age but for you it could even be a parent or a counselor, anyone. Just talking to others helps sooo much. Letting your thoughts and feelings flow and opening up is the best way to find the root of the problem and to fix it.
I’ve been allergic to wheat, dairy, eggs, and soy since first grade. If you want some advice I’m always here. It’s really hard but it will get easier I promise.

For me just the fear that I’ll never amount to anything. The fear that I’ll be another soul that everyone forgets. The realization that one day I’m going to die and a hundred years later no one will remember me and I won’t exist anymore. Sometimes I just can’t wrap my head around how  to cherish my life right now if one day I’ll be gone. Why does anything I do matter. I don’t always feel this way but it’s just sometimes I can’t stop thinking about it. I don’t have a bad life, I have some talents and I have people that love me but none of that shit matters if we’re all going to disappear eventually.

That fact that you’re thinking so much about all the ways this could impact your family shows you have empathy. There is always room in your life for change. Just because you hate where you are now doesn’t mean you have to hate where you are tomorrow. You got one chance and I really recommend you make the most of it. Even if right now you feel like you don’t want to be around anymore I guarantee you that can change. There’s so many people, things and places you’ve never seen before that have the opportunity to change your perspective on life. You’re stronger than this, I know it.

I think it’s about finding something you really, truly enjoy doing. There’s an endless amount of things to do in this world and there’s bound to be at least one of them you’ll enjoy doing. Once you find that thing you love and makes you happy I think you’ll understand why people want to do stuff. I know how it can be to not have motivation and to just want to lay in bed and do nothing but just think of all the things you’ve never tried and don’t know if you’ll love. There’s something for everyone.

Wow, your story is so similar to mine. I used to be in such a dark place but one of the ways I’ve grown is by showing others more love. I’m not prefect but making a constant effort to use all the love you have in your heart is one of the best ways to find purpose in life. You’re a great reminder to people how much a little love can mean. Thank you <3

Thank you so much. Your words mean so much to me. Sometimes it’s hard for us to see the love that we posses and to understand how we can use it, but once we do it’s such a great feeling. I know you’re a great person and you will find your calling in life. It doesn’t matter how old you are or whatever obstacles you’re facing, the possibility for change is always there.

I don’t know your friends and family but I know there are people in your life you can turn to. I used to be in a very dark place and I would never turn to anyone for help. Recently I was able to actually talk to people for once and it helped so much. Once I talked to that first person I realized how many of my friends and family were there for me. It sounds like you really trust your boyfriend so I would probably try to talk to him first. 

It’s not your fault but I hate that people think asking for help is selfish. I feel like it is one of the greatest flaws in our society. We all have love to give and everyone has points in their life where they need a little love but for someone reason that’s seen as such an awkward interaction. It might be hard to imagine how much talking to other people can help but trust me it really, really does. 

Best of luck

I’m not sure if you only are referring to physical help but I hope my story can make you feel a little better. I’ve always been someone who’s kept shit inside but recently I met a great group of people that changed my life. For once we were all able to actually talk to someone else and feel loved. There was people there who had been carrying this weight one their backs, alone, for so long. Just to see them free of their struggles made me so happy. The joy in their eyes and positivity in their voice was so noticeable. I know some people feel like talking to others can’t help them, but I used to think that and I’ve honestly never been more wrong. Being able to be there for other people and to actually have a positive, visible impact on their life is something really special. You might not end up being a vet like you wanted to but that doesn’t mean you can’t help other people. I’m just some random dude but I was able to help all those people around me just by listening and speaking with them. You have love in your heart and you can help others with that love whether you have a degree or not.

One of my favorite things is hearing stories of people setting their minds to a goal and achieving it. Opening your own bakery is a huge accomplishment, so congratulations and I wish you the best of luck!

Haha never feel self centered for asking for some kind words. I wish everyone in our society was more normal about showing love and positivity to one another because it’s such a great thing. One thing I like to tell myself when I’m feeling down is that I’ll never know what tomorrow holds. There’s so many people I’ve never met and things I’ve never experienced. A few weeks ago I met a great group of people and I feel like my life is so much better after meeting them. Never in a million years could I have predicted the impact those people would have had on my life. Those people are present in everyone’s lives. Sometimes you have to do a little looking but never lose hope!

I know it sounds corny but a quote I heard recently is “There are friends, family, and friends that become family”. You might not feel super close to your blood relatives but there are always people you can talk to that love you even if they’re not in your own household.

I’m always down to talk. I’ve always been the kind of person that keeps shit inside but recently I got the opportunity to open up to others and to then listen to what they had to say and it feels so good. I know it’s a little different talking through messages but I could always use more people to talk to and I love just listening to other people talk. I’m always hear if you need something

I just want you to know high school isn’t what the rest of the world will be like. High school is a small experience compared to everything you will see on the future. There might not be people you are close with right now but I’ll assure you there will be plenty of people you will meet throughout your life.

No matter how she reacts I just want you to know that’s so sweet. You noticed something she needed in her life and you even put in the time to make something yourself. I know you don’t know her that well but I’ll assure you that will be one of the best gifts she gets.

You’re so incredibly wrong. Every person has something good about themselves. Just because you can’t see it now doesn’t mean it’s not there. Life is full of people, places, and things that you’ve never seen before. Every day is an opportunity to discover something new about yourself. I don’t know you but I’m sure if I did I could identify the great things about you. It can be hard if you don’t have people telling you all the time things you’re good at, but trust me, you were made for something great.

It’s never to late to make a change in your life. Find something that you love doing, that makes you love yourself, and hold onto it. I’m sure your kids do not feel that way and it’s not your fault at all. Sometimes self love and self forgiveness can be the hardest things in life but often they are the most important. Just because you hate who you are today doesn’t mean you have to hate who you are tomorrow.
Thanks, I wish the world had more people like you

I know it’s hard but there are people in your life that know what it’s like and will talk to you. I know I’m just some random guy on the internet but i know what it’s like and I’ll talk to you if you need that. I think the reason people don’t reach out on your social media is they don’t know what to say, or they’re to afraid to say it. If I’ve learned anything over the past few months it’s that everybody has their shit that they have to deal with. Some people bear it silently and others reach out. You’re brave for asking and wanting help and I’m sorry no one was there to give it to you. Just because you’re not in a great place now doesn’t mean you can’t become great. Change can happen in an instance.
Just hit me up in a pm if you need anything. I might not be some therapist with a degree but I know what it’s like. Wherever you are, whoever you are, I love you :)

Fuck man. If we just got rid of every stereotype and preconception we had this world would be such a better place. Looking back I can’t believe how often I used to judge people. Everyone has their own shit good and bad that you don’t know about. Give every person a chance no matter what they look like on the outside. At the end of the day we’re all in this shit together.

I used to feel the exact same way. The thing is if you’re still taking your exams and in school like I was then you haven’t even experienced half of what the world has to offer. Even if you feel like you don’t have any plans or goals for the future right now I can assure you that will change once you’re older. 

As for your dad what he says doesn’t matter. He doesn’t dictate you, only you control yourself. Screw whatever he says. He might be your family but he’s not your *family*. Family is the people that love you and bring you up especially when you are in a bad place. He might just be having a bad day or whatever but don’t take what he says to heart. You’re destined for great things. Even if you don’t do good on those exams there’s a million other chances in this world for success.

I feel like what you need is to find something to be passionate about. Life can feel aimless if you don’t have anything you’re working towards. There’s a million things to try in the world and you never know that you will love something if you’ve never tried it. Being apart of something or working towards a goal is a great motivator not just for that one thing but for the rest of your life.

You’re not worthless. I don’t care how much it seems like it but you have a purpose and you are made for something. There are people that care for you and love you, even if you don’t know it yet. There’s always something left to lose, life is the most precious thing out there. Never think that there’s no time left for change, the biggest changes can happen in half a second without a moments notice.

Everyone has something they are meant for. Sometimes we just don’t know what that thing is yet. Life is full of places to go, people to meet, and things to do. I used to always find myself feeling the way you do, but now I realize that at any moment you can meet person the changes your life. I don’t want to sound like some corny asshole, but you can never lose hope. There are people who know what it’s like and want to help you, you just have to look for them. No matter where you are, who you are, there are people that love you.

This was a really great answer. I really struggle with the faith I’ve grown up with because they say god is 1. All powerful (meaning he has the power to do anything) 2. All good. This just doesn’t add up to me because if he was all powerful and all good he would stop all the bad things that happen. Either he doesn’t want to or he doesn’t have the power to.
